verdicts.reason: Both crop the model's face down to one eye on the edge and let the huge blue panel cover most of the image. Both leave the thin outline frame floating in the foliage, detached from the panel, and move the '14' beside the text column, which breaks the original's centred stacked reading order. A crams the text column against the top of the panel and leaves a dead blue band about 95px tall at the bottom; B spaces the content more evenly down the panel, so it is slightly less lopsided.
